memory_comment_JP: 2017年に沖縄へ行った際に撮影した首里城。
memory_comment_EN: Shuri Castle taken when I went to Okinawa in 2017.

memory_comment_JP: 出張の合間、あいにくの雨模様で駆け足で観た首里城、今度行ったらゆっくり散策しようと思っていたのに、まさかのことに驚いています。しかし、首里城はこれまで何度も蘇ってきました。琉球の歴史や文化を伝え続けるためにも、首里城が再び復活することを祈っています。
memory_comment_EN: Unfortunately, during a business trip, it was raining so I rushed to see Shuri Castle.I had planned to take a leisurely stroll next time I went there, but I was surprised by how unexpected it turned out. However, Shuri Castle has been revived many times. I pray that Shuri Castle will be revived again so that we can continue to convey the history and culture of the Ryukyus.

memory_comment_JP: 赤い、という第一印象がありつつ、本土の神社仏閣とはまた違う雰囲気を感じました。それが沖縄の王の居城そのものの意味なのかもしれません。南殿の中の展示コーナーも、とてもきれいに整備されていた印象が残っています。あとは南殿奥の書院の庭が、そこだけ日本庭園的に作られていたことも思い出されます。
memory_comment_EN: My first impression was that it was red, but I felt that it had a different atmosphere than the shrines and temples on the mainland. That may be the meaning of the Okinawa king's castle itself. I also have the impression that the exhibition corner inside the South Hall was very well maintained. I also remember that the shoin garden at the back of the south hall was designed in the style of a Japanese garden.

memory_comment_EN: When I visited at the time, it was so noisy due to restoration work that I couldn't take a good look at it. I was thinking of coming back to see it once it's completely restored. But it's gone...

memory_comment_JP: 妻と初めて行った沖縄旅行でした。赤い色が印象的でした。

memory_comment_JP: お兄ちゃんが就職しちゃうからってことのその前の最後の家族旅行で行きました！！階段きつかったのと沖縄なのに結構作りは和風なイメージがあった。模型とかもあったからもしかしたら図面データとかありそうな気が……
memory_comment_EN: We went on our last family trip before my brother got a job! ! The stairs were tough, and even though it was in Okinawa, I had the impression that the building was quite Japanese-style. There were also models, so I feel like there might be some drawing data...

memory_comment_JP:
今年の10/18に訪問したばかりで今回の火災に大変ショックを受けています。
近くからはもちろん、モノレールからも威厳のある美しい姿が見えていて、私のような観光客はもちろん、地元の方の喪失感やお気持ちにはかける言葉もありません。
正殿の前はタイムトラップして琉球国に行ったかのような圧倒的な美しさとインパクトがあり、赤や金、極彩色の装飾や様式は独特の雰囲気でした。
memory_comment_EN: I just visited on October 18th of this year and was shocked by this fire. Its majestic and beautiful appearance can be seen not only from nearby but also from the monorail, and there are no words to express the sense of loss and feelings felt not only by tourists like me but also by the locals. The front of the main hall has an overwhelming beauty and impact that makes you feel like you have traveled back in time to the Ryukyu Kingdom, and the red, gold, and richly colored decorations and style have a unique atmosphere.

memory_comment_JP: 修学旅行で観に行った時の首里城です

memory_comment_JP:
昨年、退職記念に妻と34年前新婚旅行に行った沖縄へ行きました。首里城は思っていた以上に大きく夢中になって見て廻りました。見切れなくて、また首里城へ行こうねって約束していました。

memory_comment_EN: Last year, to commemorate my retirement, my wife and I went to Okinawa, where we honeymooned 34 years ago. Shuri Castle was much bigger than I expected and I was fascinated by it. I couldn't finish it all, so I promised to go to Shuri Castle again. Also, my daughter's wedding was this November. I had promised to go to Shuri Castle with my wife, but I'm disappointed. I would like to send you a photo in case it can be of any help.

memory_comment_JP: 何度も沖縄に行きながらも、日帰りだったりとなかなか観光できない場所でした。首里城は奇遇にも先月たまたま行くことができ、実質ほぼ最期の姿を見たのかと思うと胸が苦しくなります。幸いなのは時代が今だったことでしょうか。フォトグラメトリに十分なだけの写真が集まることを祈っています。
memory_comment_EN: Although I have been to Okinawa many times, it was a place that I could not easily visit on a day trip. I was lucky enough to be able to go to Shuri Castle last month, and it makes my heart hurt to think that I actually saw him in his final moments. The good news is that the time is now. I hope I can collect enough photos for photogrammetry.

memory_comment_JP: I really love Shuri Castle. It's very beautiful.
memory_comment_EN: I really love Shuri Castle. It's very beautiful.

memory_comment_EN: It was my first time in Okinawa. It was the best castle tour I've ever had, as I was introduced to a unique culture and history that is different from Japan or China. It was very hot, but I had never sweated so much. It was the best memory.

memory_comment_JP: Shurijo in my memories, it's always beautifu.

The children enjoyed the Shuri Castle Park stamp rally, and my wife and I learned about the history of Shuri Castle. I thought of the magnificent, colorful Shuri Castle and imagined its glory in the past.

memory_comment_EN: I went on a graduation trip. I went with my classmates from the laboratory, who I spent a lot of time with, so I have very fond memories of it.

memory_comment_JP: The soul of Okinawa

memory_comment_JP: 去年亡くなった祖父と行った沖縄で、初めて首里城の中に入りました。その時に撮影したものです。祖父は高校の社会の講師だったのですが、沖縄の歴史、文化についてとても興味を持っていて、旅行中、修学旅行みたいに色々教えてくれました。

My grandfather was a high school social studies instructor, and he was very interested in the history and culture of Okinawa, and he taught me a lot of things during his travels, just like on a school trip.

memory_comment_EN: It was my first time in Okinawa and I visited Shuri Castle for the first time.  I was overwhelmed by the scale and it was one of the most impressive things I did on this trip.

memory_comment_JP: 琉球文化を堪能できる場所でした。　県立博物館もいいですけど、やっぱり首里城が最高でしたね。
memory_comment_EN: It was a place where you could enjoy Ryukyu culture to the fullest. The Prefectural Museum is nice, but Shuri Castle was definitely the best.

memory_comment_JP: Impressive, grand, historical, beautiful heritage. Nice view from top of the castle area. Surprising history of the castle. Great renovation of the castle interior.
memory_comment_EN: Impressive, grand, historical, beautiful heritage. Nice view from top of the castle area. Surprising history of the castle. Great renovation of the castle interior.

生まれも育ちも首里城のたもと

毎日見てきた姿が目に残っています
memory_comment_EN: I was born and raised at the foot of Shuri Castle The sight I saw every day remains in my eyes.

memory_comment_JP: 沖縄戦で完全に破壊され、戦後に復元されたとはいえ首里城の壮大さには圧倒された。そして戦火で失われた首里城には歴代琉球王の姿を描いた「御後絵」が所蔵されてて同じく焼失したものの、鎌倉芳太郎によりガラス乾板にモノクロで撮影されたものだけが残されて、それを元に想像された当時の色使いでの御後絵が近年カラーで再現されたというニュースを聞いて嬉しく思った。
memory_comment_EN: Although it was completely destroyed during the Battle of Okinawa and was restored after the war, I was overwhelmed by the grandeur of Shuri Castle. Shuri Castle, which was lost in the war, had a collection of ``Gogo-e'' depicting the figures of successive Ryukyu kings, and although it was also destroyed in a fire, only the black-and-white photo taken on a glass plate by Yoshitaro Kamakura remains. I was pleased to hear that the Gogo-e, which was imagined based on this, has recently been reproduced in color.

memory_comment_JP:
私が生まれた時まだ沖縄はアメリカでした
その後日本に返還されましたが身体が生まれつき弱く旅行へもあまりいけませんでした
城が好きだった事もあり、いつか行ってみたいと思い復興後念願の首里城へ数年前やっと
行くことができて感激しておりました
なので今回の火災は残念でとても悲しく思いました
何年かかっても絶対に復興してもらいたいです
memory_comment_EN: When I was born, Okinawa was still part of the United States. After that, it was returned to Japan, but I was born with a weak body and couldn't travel much. I loved castles, and I wanted to go there someday, so after the recovery, I decided to make a dream of going there. I was very moved when I finally got to go to Shuri Castle a few years ago, so I was very saddened by the recent fire.I definitely want it to be restored, no matter how many years it takes.

memory_comment_JP:
中学三年生の時に訪れました。
当時はまだ修復工事の途中だったので少し残念でしたが、その豪華絢爛な姿を目にする事が出来て本当に良かったです。
memory_comment_EN: visited when I was in the third year of junior high school. At that time, it was still in the middle of restoration work, so I was a little disappointed, but I was really glad to be able to see its gorgeous appearance.

memory_comment_JP:
まだ首里城に行ったことがなく、そのうちにと思っていたところのこの火事でとても残念です。復元に３０年かかったとのこと、合わせて技術者、材料の確保の問題もあるようで、復元するにしても時間がかかりそう。行けなかった首里城をVRで見たり復元時の確認資料になるといいなと思います。
友人からもらったデータですが使っていただければと思います。
memory_comment_EN: I haven't been to Shuri Castle yet, and I was thinking of visiting it sometime soon, so I'm very disappointed in the fire. It is said that it took 30 years to restore it, and there are also problems with securing engineers and materials, so it seems that it will take a long time even if it is restored. I think it would be great if you could see Shuri Castle in VR, which you couldn't go to, and use it as confirmation material when restoring it. I received this data from a friend, but I hope you will use it.

memory_comment_JP:
沖縄は若い頃に４回旅行しました。離島に行った時以外の３回は那覇を訪れて、首里城に行きました。小高い丘の上のお気に入りの場所でした。
2003年は４回目で、息子が3歳、娘が0歳の時です。子供が小さく大変な時期でしたが、やはり沖縄に行きたくて連れて行きました。息子がポーズを決めていて、近くに来ないので、奇妙な写真になっています。子供は小さかったので、首里城のことは何も覚えてないでしょう。
子供たちが南部戦跡の意味がわかるような年齢になったら、修学旅行で、あるいはまた家族で、沖縄を訪れることもあろうと思っていました。
結局、修学旅行は沖縄ではなく、今年2019年の夏の家族旅行で沖縄も候補に上がったのですが、訪れることなく、子供の記憶には写真の中の首里城だけが残ることになってしまい、とても残念です。
何とか再建させて、大きくなった子供たちとまた首里城を訪れたいと心より願っています。
memory_comment_EN: traveled to Okinawa four times when I was young. Other than when I went to a remote island, I visited Naha three times and went to Shuri Castle. It was my favorite spot on top of a small hill. The fourth time was in 2003, when my son was 3 years old and my daughter was 0 years old. It was a difficult time when my children were small, but I still wanted to go to Okinawa, so I took them there. My son is posing and doesn't come near me, so it's a strange photo. Since the children were young, they probably don't remember anything about Shuri Castle. I thought that when my children were old enough to understand the meaning of the Southern Battle Sites, they would visit Okinawa on a school trip or again as a family. In the end, the school trip wasn't to Okinawa, but Okinawa was also a candidate for a summer family trip this year in 2019, but we never visited, and the only thing that remained in our children's memories was Shuri Castle in the photo. I'm very sorry. I sincerely hope that I can somehow rebuild it and visit Shuri Castle again with my grown children.

memory_comment_JP: 沖縄での単身アパート暮らしを初めて半年経過した時に、妻と娘が暮らしぶりを見にきたとにき首里城を訪れた際に撮影、一部は娘の携帯で撮影した画像
memory_comment_EN: This photo was taken when my wife and daughter visited Shuri Castle to see how I was living after living alone in an apartment for the first time in Okinawa for half a year.Some images were taken with my daughter's cell phone.

memory_comment_JP: 首里城へは小学生の頃家族旅行でも、高校の修学旅行でも行きました。小学生で初めて行った時、子どもながらにそのスケールと独特の雰囲気に圧倒されたことを今でもよく覚えています。
memory_comment_EN: I went to Shuri Castle both as a family trip when I was in elementary school and on a school trip in high school. The first time I went there as an elementary school student, I still remember being overwhelmed by the scale and unique atmosphere.

memory_comment_JP:
高校の修学旅行で初めて沖縄に行った時の最終日です。
朱色でこんな色鮮やかな城は初めて見ました。
2年前に沖縄に行った際には、閉園時間で見ることができずこの写真が最初で最後の首里城でした。
memory_comment_EN: It was the last day of my first high school trip to Okinawa. It was my first time to see such a brightly colored castle. When I went to Okinawa two years ago, I couldn't see it because the park was closed, so this photo was my first and last shot of Shuri Castle.

memory_comment_JP: 初めての沖縄でした。本州とは見た目も文化も制度も何もかも違う琉球に身心ともにどっぷりつかることができてとても興味深かったです。
memory_comment_EN: It was my first time in Okinawa. It was very interesting to be able to fully immerse myself both physically and mentally in Ryukyu, which is different from Honshu in appearance, culture, and system.

memory_comment_JP:
初めての沖縄旅行、誕生日に合わせて母と行きました。

首里城は、現地のガイドさんにご説明いただきながら拝観しました。

私達の住む街は古くから沖縄と親交のある街でしたので、ガイドさんと盛り上がりながら回ったのを覚えています。
memory_comment_EN: It was my first trip to Okinawa, and I went with my mom to coincide with her birthday.  We visited Shuri Castle while being given an explanation by a local guide.  The town we live in has long had a close relationship with Okinawa, so I remember having fun touring around with our guide.

memory_comment_JP:
"2016年に仕事で体調を崩した時に主人と久高島などと回りました。
首里城は御嶽のある崇高な場所です。
学生の時に来た時はまだ首里城の復元はなく、外国ナンバーのバンパーがボロボロの車が道路を堂々と走っていました。
番組で首里城周辺の琉球石灰岩や泥岩の湧き水による泡盛古酒やそれを守る空手の誕生などの歴史を知り、王宮の物語テンペストもみて、巡る旅になりました。
復元された首里城に立つと、誇り高い王朝の歴史や泡盛古酒まで破壊してしまう沖縄戦の悲しい歴史の重みを背負いながら前向きに立ち上がる県民の方々の強さを感じられずにはいられませんでした。"
memory_comment_EN:
In 2016, when I fell ill due to work, my husband and I went to Kudaka Island and other places. 
 Shuri Castle is a sublime place with a Utaki. 
 When I came here as a student, Shuri Castle had not yet been restored, and cars with foreign license plates and battered bumpers were driving proudly along the road. 
 Through the program, I learned about the history of old awamori sake made from spring water from Ryukyu limestone and mudstone around Shuri Castle, and the birth of the karate that protects it, and I also watched Tempest, the story of the royal palace, which led me to a tour. 
 Standing at the restored Shuri Castle, I can't help but feel the strength of the people of the prefecture who stand up positive despite bearing the weight of the proud history of the dynasty and the sad history of the Battle of Okinawa, which destroyed even old awamori sake. I couldn't.

memory_comment_JP:
沖縄通いを始めた2002年ごろから、首里城を訪れていました。

将来はこの地に住みたいと思い、そして現在、自宅も持つことができました。

純粋な観光客として見ていた首里城、沖縄の歴史をもっと知りたいと尋ねた首里城、お正月やお祭りを楽しんだ首里城…。ここだけは変わらずにいてくれて、変化してきた自分を思い返しています。
memory_comment_EN: I have been visiting Shuri Castle since around 2002, when I started commuting to Okinawa.  I want to live here in the future, and now I have my own home.  Shuri Castle that I saw as a pure tourist, Shuri Castle that I asked to know more about the history of Okinawa, Shuri Castle where I enjoyed New Year's and festivals... This is the only thing that has remained the same, and I am thinking back on how much I have changed.

memory_comment_JP:
小さい頃には家族と大学に入ってからツールド沖縄参加がてら、今年は卒業旅行も込めて同じサークルの友人達と訪れました。

沖縄に行けば絶対に脚を運ぶスポットで、他の世界遺産とともに楽しませてもらった。

沖縄の青い空に映える赤が好き。
memory_comment_EN: When I was little, my family and I participated in the Tour de Okinawa after entering university, and this year I visited with friends from the same circle as part of my graduation trip.  It's a must-visit spot when you go to Okinawa, and I enjoyed it along with other world heritage sites.  I like the red that stands out against the blue sky of Okinawa.

memory_comment_JP: 城壁の美しい曲線にほれぼれしながらのんびりひとりで散策しました。
memory_comment_EN: I took a leisurely stroll by myself, admiring the beautiful curves of the castle walls.

memory_comment_JP: 沖縄の宿泊チケットが当たったので、意気揚々と1人旅で向かいました。ただ、この時はまだ改装中で、綺麗な首里城は見れませんでした。新しくなった首里城をまた見れる日が来ることを楽しみにしてました。
memory_comment_EN: I won a ticket to stay in Okinawa, so I headed there on my own in high spirits. However, at that time it was still under renovation, so I couldn't see the beautiful Shuri Castle. I was looking forward to the day when I could see the new Shuri Castle again.

memory_comment_JP:
20120110の4枚

叔母と母と姉と女4人で旅行したときの写真です。



20190620の2枚

夫と1泊で沖縄旅行に行きました。
memory_comment_EN: 4 photos from 20120110 These are photos taken when I traveled with my aunt, mother, sister, and four other women.   2 photos from 20190620 My husband and I went on a trip to Okinawa for one night.

memory_comment_JP: このプロジェクト発起人の一人である喜納大作先生の本を持って首里城を訪れました。首里城に恋い焦がれての訪問でした。モノレールから見える首里城にやっと会えたという安堵感が広がったことを覚えています。戦禍を越えて流れ出る湧き水、そして龍樋。龍潭の向こうに見える北殿、正殿。御庭からみる正殿。西のアザナからの那覇港や泊港の眺め。どれをとっても琉球王国に生きた人たちを感じながら眺めることができました。５年たったら御内原が完成するとのことでしたので、訪問を楽しみにしていたのですがそれが叶わずとても残念でなりません。近いうちにまた首里城を訪れ、復元に向けた沖縄のみなさまの力強い心意気を感じたいと思います。
memory_comment_EN: visited Shuri Castle with a book written by Daisaku Kino, one of the founders of this project. I visited Shuri Castle because I was in love with it. I remember feeling a sense of relief at finally being able to see Shuri Castle as seen from the monorail. The spring water that has overcome the damage of war, and the dragon gutter. The North Hall and Seiden Hall can be seen across Ryutan. Seiden seen from the garden. A view of Naha Port and Tomari Port from Azana in the west. No matter which one I looked at, I could feel the people who lived in the Ryukyu Kingdom while looking at them. I was looking forward to visiting Ouchihara because it was said that it would be completed in five years, but I am very disappointed that it was not possible. I would like to visit Shuri Castle again in the near future and feel the strong spirit of the people of Okinawa towards its restoration.

memory_comment_JP: 長男が生まれる直前、いわゆる産前旅行で訪れました。「しばらくふたりの時間は持てないかもしれないけれど、楽しみだね」という話をしたことを覚えています。とても大切な思い出です。
memory_comment_EN: Just before my first son was born, I visited here on a so-called prenatal trip. I remember saying, ``We may not be able to spend time together for a while, but I'm looking forward to it.'' It's a very important memory.

memory_comment_JP: 専門ではありませんが、中国や韓国などと琉球と京都・奈良などそれぞれの建築様式の相違や類似に興味がありました。
memory_comment_EN: Although I am not an expert, I am interested in the differences and similarities between the architectural styles of China, Korea, Ryukyu, Kyoto, and Nara.

memory_comment_JP:
I was studied master degree in Japan and I went there with my husband.

The castle was stunning beautiful. It looked new and well-maintained.
memory_comment_EN: I was studied master degree in Japan and I went there with my husband. The castle was stunning beautiful. It looked new and well-maintained.

memory_comment_JP: アルバイトの同期と初めて行った時の写真です。初めての首里城、初めてのみんなでの旅行、全部が楽しかった思い出です。
memory_comment_EN: This is a photo from when I went there for the first time with my colleague from a part-time job. My first time at Shuri Castle, my first trip together, all of them are fond memories.

memory_comment_JP:
2004-06-12　の写真はアジアへの長旅の起点として沖縄に初めて渡った時のものです。旅の起点が沖縄でした。

2018-05-26　の写真は休日に沖縄の海を目的として訪れた時のものです。14年の時とともに、自身の旅が変わりました。
memory_comment_EN: The photo taken on 2004-06-12 was taken when I first went to Okinawa as the starting point of a long journey to Asia. The starting point of the trip was Okinawa.  The photo on 2018-05-26 was taken when I visited Okinawa on a holiday to see the sea. Over the past 14 years, my journey has changed.

memory_comment_JP: I used to live in Okinawa for about 4 years. I visited the castle quite a few times, and even brought friends and family to see this wonderful piece of history. The New Year tea ceremony was such a wonderful thing to experience here.
memory_comment_EN: I used to live in Okinawa for about 4 years. I visited the castle quite a few times, and even brought friends and family to see this wonderful piece of history. The New Year tea ceremony was such a wonderful thing to experience here.

memory_comment_JP: ヤンチャなこどもたちと一緒に、家族旅行で訪れました。沖縄は何度も出張で訪れていますが、首里城に出かけたのはこの時だけです。
memory_comment_EN: visited on a family trip with my mischievous children. I have visited Okinawa many times on business, but this was the only time I went to Shuri Castle.

memory_comment_JP: 与那国、石垣、最後に沖縄本島、35年ぶりの本島でした、城跡だったところに、美しい宮殿が再建されて喜んで観光したのに、残念でなりません。
memory_comment_EN: Yonaguni, Ishigaki, and finally the main island of Okinawa. It was my first time on the main island in 35 years. I was so disappointed because I was so happy to see the beautiful palace that was rebuilt on the former castle ruins.

memory_comment_JP: 初めて家族で沖縄を訪れたときに首里城を見学しました。その後NHKでドラマ「琉球の風｣が放映され、実際に見た景色と重ねて感激しました。
memory_comment_EN: When I visited Okinawa with my family for the first time, we toured Shuri Castle. After that, the drama ``Ryukyu no Kaze'' was aired on NHK, and I was deeply moved by the scenery I had actually seen.

memory_comment_JP: In 2016 , this is first time for me to visit Okinawa. In Sep8’2016 is the first day that I was arrived. The picture that I upload , it just only model because at that time it was still construction. I don’t know how much I can help.
memory_comment_EN: In 2016 , this is first time for me to visit Okinawa. In Sep8'2016 is the first day that I was arrived. The picture that I upload , it just only model because at that time it was still construction. I don't know how much I can help.

memory_comment_JP: Fist time to visit. This castle is wonderful place to big the main building so wonderful even still construction.
memory_comment_EN: Fist time to visit. This castle is wonderful place to big the main building so wonderful even still construction.

memory_comment_JP: 沖縄の誇りだった首里城、一日も早く元の姿を取り戻せることを願っています。
memory_comment_EN: I hope that Shuri Castle, which was the pride of Okinawa, can be restored to its former state as soon as possible.

memory_comment_JP: 辺野古埋め立てなどが問題となっていて、一度自分の目で見ておきたかった。米軍基地周辺は観光産業が発展していない様子が印象的だったが、首里城は美しかった。事前に小説「テンペスト」を読んで行ったため、ここで誰がこうして、ととても楽しんだだけに残念。早期復興に期待します。
memory_comment_EN: Henoko land reclamation has become an issue, and I wanted to see it with my own eyes. I was impressed by the lack of development of the tourism industry around the US military base, but Shuri Castle was beautiful. It's a shame because I had read the novel "The Tempest" beforehand and really enjoyed it, wondering who was doing this here. We hope for early recovery.

memory_comment_JP:
このたびは大変残念なことでしたが、家族でいった大切な思い出の場所が燃えて心が痛い思いです。

写真は日付が飛んでてちょっとわかりかねますが4−5年前だったと思います。
memory_comment_EN: This is a very unfortunate incident, but I am heartbroken that the place where I had so many precious memories with my family was burnt down.  The date on the photo is skipped so it's a little hard to tell, but I think it was taken 4-5 years ago.

memory_comment_JP: 沖縄が琉球王国という一つの国家であったという事実を具体的に実感したことが印象深く。私たちが安易に沖縄返還などと言ってきたことを反省させられました。そんな思い出があります。
memory_comment_EN: It left a deep impression on me that I was able to concretely realize the fact that Okinawa was once a nation called the Ryukyu Kingdom. It made me reflect on how easily we had called for the return of Okinawa. I have such memories.

memory_comment_JP:
仲の良い友人と沖縄旅行に行った際に首里城を訪れました。

建物、内部の美しさに感動したのを覚えています。
memory_comment_EN: I visited Shuri Castle when I went on a trip to Okinawa with a good friend.  I remember being impressed by the beauty of the building and its interior.

memory_comment_JP:
実家と自宅は、首里城の近くです。

小さい頃から家族で遊んだり散歩したりしてました。

結婚して夫は北海道出身。首里城の中を見たことがないこと、

首里城がやっと完成したこともあり散歩がてら行く事に。

その日は天気も良く、東京にいる沖縄出身の友人の為に新しく完成した場所、首里城の後から撮影しました。
memory_comment_EN: My parents' house and home are near Shuri Castle.  Ever since I was little, I have been playing with my family and going for walks.  I am married and my husband is from Hokkaido. I have never seen the inside of Shuri Castle,  Since Shuri Castle was finally completed, I decided to go for a walk.  The weather was nice that day, and I took a photo from behind Shuri Castle, a newly completed site for my Okinawan friend in Tokyo.

memory_comment_JP:
仕事や観光で少しだけ訪れた際、一度は行くべきところと思い立ち寄りました。

まだ修復工事中で完成した時のイメージができる段階の状況だったかと思います。

修復が完了したらもう一度訪れたいと思っていた矢先の出来事で大変ショックです。

でもなんどもたくさんの方々の努力で再建されて来た歴史から、また必ず修復されることを願っています。
memory_comment_EN: When I visited for a short time for work or sightseeing, I stopped by thinking it was a place I should visit at least once.  I think it was still in the process of being repaired and we were at the stage where we could imagine what it would look like when it was completed.  I was really looking forward to visiting again once the restoration was completed, but this happened just as I was in shock.  However, since it has been rebuilt many times through the efforts of many people, I hope that it will be restored again.

memory_comment_JP:
このとき初めて首里城に行って、赤いお城に衝撃を受けました。

とても華やかで南国らしくて感動したのを覚えています。
memory_comment_EN: At this time, I went to Shuri Castle for the first time and was shocked by the red castle.  I remember being moved by how gorgeous and tropical it felt.

memory_comment_JP: 2度目に首里城に行ったとき。連れが仕事だったので、一人で行って隅々まで見学しました。中の展示もとても素敵だったのを覚えています。
memory_comment_EN: The second time I went to Shuri Castle. My companion was at work, so I went by myself and toured every corner. I remember that the exhibits inside were also very nice.

memory_comment_JP:
これらの写真は私のパートナーである女性（28歳）が撮影したものです。本人の許諾を得た上でアップロードさせて頂きました。
下記の思い出につきましても、本人から送付されたテキストをそのまま転載致しました。


「過去にこの場所で国王を囲んで多くの人々が関わり生活をしていたと思うと本当に感動しました。お城からの見晴らしもとても良くて美しい場所でした。
今回の火災は本当にショックです。少ない写真ですが少しでもお役に立てればと思います。」
memory_comment_EN: These photos were taken by my female partner (28 years old). It was uploaded with the permission of the person in question. Regarding the memories below, I have reproduced the text sent to me by the person himself. ``It was really moving to think that in the past many people lived in this place surrounding the king.The view from the castle was also very good and it was a beautiful place.This fire is a real shock. I hope this photo can be of some help."

memory_comment_JP:
I went to Okinawa this October2019!  I came to see Shuri Castle. It was a very nice building!  There is no word in the event of a fire too sad!  I hope for a quick restoration.💙

#Shurimemories
memory_comment_EN: I went to Okinawa this October2019! I came to see Shuri Castle. It was a very nice building! There is no word in the event of a fire too sad! I hope for a quick restoration.💙 #Shurimemories

memory_comment_JP: 日本全国を巡っていた頃、本土の都道府県は終了し、残すは沖縄県だけになつてましたが、2013年に訪れる機会に恵まれ、首里城にも行かせてもらいました。これで日本一周が終わったという感慨に浸ったことを思い出します。青い空、青い海、本土とは違う琉球王国という文化に育まれた沖縄、その象徴とも言える、首里城が火災で失われた事は残念です。正殿内部の写真もありますが、必要ならご連絡下さい。
memory_comment_EN: By the time I was touring all over Japan, all the prefectures on the mainland had disappeared, leaving only Okinawa Prefecture, but I had the opportunity to visit in 2013 and was also able to visit Shuri Castle. I remember being immersed in the feeling of having completed my trip around Japan. It is a shame that Shuri Castle, a symbol of Okinawa's history of blue skies, blue seas, and the culture of the Ryukyu Kingdom, which is different from the mainland, was lost in a fire. I also have photos of the inside of the Seiden, but if you need them, please contact me.

memory_comment_JP: この日は非常に暑い日でした。ずっとそこに存在し続けると、なんの疑問もなく信じていた首里城が、わずか半年後に跡形もなく消失してしまったことに非常にショックを受けました。拙い写真が何らかのお役に立てば幸いです。
memory_comment_EN: It was a very hot day. I was extremely shocked to see that Shuri Castle, which I believed without question would continue to exist there, disappeared without a trace just six months later. I hope my poor photos are of some use.

memory_comment_JP:
まとまった休みが取れると沖縄に何度も旅行し、
車で様々な城や戦争の傷あとをたどり、
様々なことをいろいろな角度から見聞きしてきました。
その旅の中で首里城も訪れました。

痛みや悲しみを乗り越えて築き上げてきた
現在の明るい沖縄が
どれほど尊いのかを感じる旅は
まだまだ続けたいと思っています。

沖縄の歴史から多くのことを学び、
子どもたちの未来のために
何ができるのかを考えるための
旅でもあります。

貴重な資料までもたくさん焼失してしまい、
悲しくて胸が痛いです。
首里城が再び蘇り、
傷ついた沖縄の方々の心の痛みが
薄れる日が来ることを願っています。

またゆっくりと見学するつもりでいたので、
少ししか写真を撮らなかったことが
悔やまれます。

少しでもお役に立てればと思い提供させていただきます。
memory_comment_EN:
Whenever I had ample time off, I traveled to Okinawa many times, 
 driving around various castles and the scars of war, 
 seeing and hearing about various things from various angles. 
 During that trip, I also visited Shuri Castle. 
 
 The bright Okinawa that we have built after overcoming pain and sadness
 The journey that makes us realize how precious it is 
 I want to continue. 
 
 It is also a journey to learn a lot from Okinawa's history and think about what we can do for the future of our children. 
 
 Many valuable materials were destroyed in the fire, 
 I am sad and heartbroken. 
 I hope that the day will come when Shuri Castle will be revived again, and the pain 
 of the injured Okinawan people will fade 
. 
 
 I was planning to take a leisurely tour again, so 
 I regret that I only took a few photos. 
 
 I would like to provide this in the hope that it will be of some help.

memory_comment_JP: My mother is from Okinawa and all her family lives there, I’m fortunate enough to visit many times but this was my first visit th Shurijo Castle. I love every opportunity to learn more of my culture each time I return, it makes me appreciate this visit and the photos so much more but also saddens me that this historical place was destroyed for a second time. It’s a strong culture and it will never be lost.
memory_comment_EN: My mother is from Okinawa and all her family lives there, I'm fortunate enough to visit many times but this was my first visit th Shurijo Castle. I love every opportunity to learn more of my culture each time I return, it makes me appreciate this visit and the photos so much more but also saddens me that this historical place was destroyed for a second time. It's a strong culture and it will never be lost.

memory_comment_JP:
沖縄生まれ東京育ちの私は、子供の時は毎年の夏休みに、沖縄の祖父母や親戚たちに会いに行っていました。中でも首里城は、姉と妹と3人で毎回遊びに行っていた、思い出の場所です。歴史的な価値などは当時はよく分かりませんでしたが、色鮮やかで見ていて楽しく、アトラクション的にワクワクする場所でした。

物理的な復元が難しくても、デジタル復元が可能なら、本プロジェクトに是非参加させてください。
memory_comment_EN: Born in Okinawa and raised in Tokyo, when I was a child I used to visit my grandparents and relatives in Okinawa every summer vacation. Among them, Shuri Castle is a place that I have fond memories of, as my older sister and I used to visit there every time. At the time, I didn't really understand its historical value, but it was a brightly colored, fun place to look at, and an exciting attraction.  Even if physical restoration is difficult, if digital restoration is possible, please participate in this project.

memory_comment_JP:
2006年頃に首里城に行きました。その日は空が曇りで小降りの雨が降っていました。



でも首里城は本当に美しいです。

内部を見回って首里城を出た時には晴れて綺麗な夕日が那覇の街並みを赤く染め上げました。



あの光景は今でも鮮明に覚えています。
memory_comment_EN: I went to Shuri Castle around 2006. On that day, the sky was cloudy and it was raining lightly.   But Shuri Castle is really beautiful.  When I left Shuri Castle after looking around inside, it was clear and the beautiful sunset dyed the streets of Naha red.   I still remember that scene clearly.

memory_comment_JP: 高校生の修学旅行の時は正殿が工事中でしっかり見れなくて、でも今年の夏は完成した首里城を家族全員で見ることができたことがすごく嬉しかったです。
memory_comment_EN: When my high school students went on a school trip, I couldn't really see the Seiden because it was under construction, but I was really happy that my whole family was able to see the completed Shuri Castle this summer.

memory_comment_JP: 社員旅行で初めて沖縄に訪れたときに首里城にも行きました。
memory_comment_EN: When I visited Okinawa for the first time on a company trip, I also went to Shuri Castle.

memory_comment_JP: 1１年前、新婚旅行で訪れました。幼なじみ同士の結婚でしたので、正直結婚生活にもあまり新鮮味はなかったのですが、この沖縄への新婚旅行はとても楽しく、今でも家族でこの写真を眺めては、当時の思い出話に花を咲かせています。来年は娘二人と４人で行こうと話し合っていたのですが、思い出の首里城があんなことになってしまって、本当に残念です。
memory_comment_EN: I visited there on my honeymoon 11 years ago. Since the marriage was between childhood friends, to be honest, there wasn't much newness to our married life, but our honeymoon to Okinawa was a lot of fun, and even now, when we look at this photo as a family, we reminisce about those days. It is blooming. I had been talking about going there with my two daughters next year, but I'm really disappointed that Shuri Castle, which has so many memories, turned into something like that.

memory_comment_JP:
家族で訪れた首里城。

アイスもすぐに溶けてしまうくらい暑い日でした。
memory_comment_EN: visited Shuri Castle with my family.  It was such a hot day that even the ice cream melted quickly.

memory_comment_JP: 大学の友人と卒業旅行で行きました。首里城の火災があった日にこの写真を友人に送ったところ、みんな同じ写真を見ていたと教えてくれました。
memory_comment_EN: I went on a graduation trip with a friend from college. When I sent this photo to my friends on the day of the Shuri Castle fire, they told me that they had all seen the same photo.

memory_comment_JP: 行ったことなかったのでデートで行きました、まだ修復途中で正面からは撮ってないんですが横から撮ったのが残ってたので送ります。
memory_comment_EN: I had never been there before, so I went there on a date. It's still under restoration so I haven't taken any pictures from the front, but I did have some pictures taken from the side, so I'll send them to you.

memory_comment_JP: ４年前初めての沖縄旅行、新婚旅行で訪れました。その後１年前に新しい家族と一緒に訪れ節目みたいな感じで訪れ、自分の故郷ではないけど、とても身近な場所だと思っています。
memory_comment_EN: I went on my first trip to Okinawa four years ago on my honeymoon. Then a year ago, I visited there with my new family and it felt like a turning point, and although it's not my hometown, I feel that it's a place that's very familiar to me.

memory_comment_JP: 8年ぶりの首里城。当時は改修中だったため、改修後の美しい姿を見れて感動しました。いつの日か、またこの美しさを世界中の人々も見ていただきたいです。
memory_comment_EN: Shuri Castle for the first time in 8 years. It was under renovation at the time, so I was moved to see how beautiful it looked after renovations. I hope that someday people all over the world will see this beauty again.

memory_comment_JP:
沖縄が好きでよく行っていました。

早く首里城が復興されることを願ってます。
memory_comment_EN: I love Okinawa and go there often.  I hope Shuri Castle will be rebuilt soon.

memory_comment_JP: 同業の団体で伺いました。幹事役を務めた旅行でしたので、心に残っています。
memory_comment_EN: I visited with a group in the same industry. I served as the organizer for this trip, so it remains in my heart.

memory_comment_JP: 高校の時の修学旅行です。初めて見たときの壮大な見た目がなんとも言えなかったです。
memory_comment_EN: This is a school trip when I was in high school. When I saw it for the first time, I couldn't describe how magnificent it looked.

memory_comment_JP: 新婚旅行で訪れました。修学旅行の時以来、実に10年以上ぶりでした。
memory_comment_EN: I visited on my honeymoon. It's been over 10 years since we went on a school trip.

memory_comment_JP:
父親の主治医から、父親は脊髄をかなり痛めていて、そのうち歩けなくなる....
と、宣告され家族との最後の旅行に行く事にしました。
最後の家族旅行に行くなら父親が一度も行った事の無い沖縄....首里城を、死ぬまでに一度見てみたい、と言っていた事を思い出し沖縄へ高齢の父親、私、旦那、娘の4人で9/26〜9/29、3泊4日の旅で最終日に首里城を見てきました。
実は、私と娘は首里城2回目でした....何度見ても、素晴らしい琉球王国の建物でした。
見事な首里城に父親は大変喜び、目を輝かせ首里城の中にいたスタッフに色々質問をしていました。
脊髄を痛めている父親には、とても思えませんでした。
沖縄旅行から帰っても首里城は良かった♪首里城は、そこら辺にある城とは違い中も綺麗で素晴らしい！宝物もたくさん展示されていて、凄く良かった！
と口癖のように言ってました。
沖縄旅行から帰った父親は脊髄は痛めていますが元気になりました。

首里城には人を元気にさせる力もあるんだ。
と言う事に気づかされた沖縄旅行でした。

首里城..,ありがとう。
memory_comment_EN:
My father's doctor told him that he had seriously injured his spinal cord and would soon be unable to walk...
, so we decided to go on one last trip with our family. 
 If we were to go on our last family trip, we would go to Okinawa, where my father had never been....I remembered that he had said that he wanted to see Shuri Castle once before he died, so my elderly father, myself, and my husband went to Okinawa. , my daughter and I went on a 3-night, 4-day trip from September 26th to September 29th, and on the last day we visited Shuri Castle. 
 Actually, my daughter and I visited Shuri Castle for the second time....No matter how many times we saw it, it was still a wonderful building of the Ryukyu Kingdom. 
 My father was very happy to see the beautiful Shuri Castle, and his eyes lit up as he asked various questions to the staff inside Shuri Castle. 
 I couldn't believe it for my father who has spinal cord injuries. 
 Shuri Castle was great after returning from my trip to Okinawa ♪ Shuri Castle is beautiful and amazing inside, unlike other castles around here! There were a lot of treasures on display, which was really cool! 
 he said like a catchphrase. 
 My father returned from a trip to Okinawa and is feeling better, although his spinal cord is injured. 
 
 Shuri Castle also has the power to energize people. 
 It was my trip to Okinawa that made me realize this. 
 
 Shuri Castle..,Thank you.

memory_comment_JP:
かつて琉球王国という国があり、アジアの一つの貿易国として、多くの人々が訪ねて来たことを伺い知りました。



NHKのプロジェクトxという番組で首里城を取り上げていました。多くの未収録資料がディレクターの手元に残っているはずです。



復元作業をどうぞ、よろしくお願いいたします。



使用されるかはわからないなですが、写真中の息子の顔は隠して頂けますようにお願いいたします。
memory_comment_EN: I learned that there was once a country called the Ryukyu Kingdom, and that many people came to visit as a trading nation in Asia.   Shuri Castle was featured on the NHK program Project x. There must be a lot of unrecorded material left in the hands of the director.   Thank you for your cooperation in the restoration work.   I don't know if it will be used, but please hide my son's face in the photo.

memory_comment_JP: 久しぶりに家族旅行で沖縄へ行きました。完全に完成した首里城公園に訪れた時の写真です。何度も沖縄へ行きましたが、いつ訪れても素晴らしい建造物だと思います。
memory_comment_EN: I went on a family trip to Okinawa for the first time in a while. This is a photo taken when I visited the completely completed Shurijo Castle Park. I've been to Okinawa many times, and every time I visit, I think it's a wonderful building.

memory_comment_JP:
18年ぶりの親子旅行

素敵な思い出を有難うございました。
memory_comment_EN: First family trip in 18 years Thank you for the wonderful memories.

memory_comment_JP:
ちょうど焼けてしまう直前のお正月、元日イベント中の首里城の写真です。

私にとって初めて訪れた首里城でした。首里城の綺麗な赤が快晴の青空に良く映え、清々しい気持ちで新年を迎えることができたのを覚えています。それだけに、今回の焼失がとても悲しく、このプロジェクトに協力したいと思いました。
memory_comment_EN: This is a photo of Shuri Castle during the New Year's Day event just before it was burnt down.  It was my first time visiting Shuri Castle. I remember that the beautiful red color of Shuri Castle stood out against the clear blue sky, and I was able to welcome the new year with a refreshing feeling. That's why I was so saddened by the fire and wanted to cooperate with this project.

memory_comment_JP: 出張でしたが初めて行った沖縄で、仕事の合間に訪れました。正殿の美しさに圧倒されたのはもちろん、内部もすばらしく歴史好きの私はあっという間にとりこになりました。訪問してからわずか3ヶ月後にあのようなことになり、悲嘆に暮れています。私の写真が少しでも復興に役立つことを祈念しています。
memory_comment_EN: It was my first time in Okinawa, even though I was on a business trip, and I visited during my break from work. Not only was I overwhelmed by the beauty of the Seiden, but the interior was also amazing, and as a history buff, I was instantly captivated. I am heartbroken that this happened just three months after my visit. I hope that my photos will be of some help in the reconstruction efforts.

memory_comment_JP: とても綺麗な建物で沖縄に来てよかったと思った。
memory_comment_EN: The building was so beautiful that I was glad I came to Okinawa.

memory_comment_JP: 琉球王国について、日本人としてもっと学ぶべきだと感じました。
memory_comment_EN: As a Japanese, I felt that I should learn more about the Ryukyu Kingdom.

memory_comment_JP:
修学旅行で行きました。

初めて首里城を見た時に、引き込まれるほど素晴らしいものだと思いました。

とてもいい思い出になりました。
memory_comment_EN: I went on a school trip.  When I first saw Shuri Castle, I thought it was so wonderful that I was drawn to it.  It was a very good memory.

memory_comment_JP:
去年(2018年)に高校の修学旅行に行った時に撮りました。

本当にいい思い出です。どうか再建が進むようお祈りしています。
memory_comment_EN: I took this photo when I went on a high school field trip last year (2018).  It's a really good memory. I pray that the reconstruction will proceed.

memory_comment_JP: 修学旅行で首里城が燃える2日前に見ることができました。修学旅行最終日の朝に首里城が燃えたというニュースを見てびっくりして、とても悲しく思いました。早く復元されることを願っています。
memory_comment_EN: I was able to see Shuri Castle on a school trip two days before it burned. On the morning of the last day of the school trip, I was shocked and very sad when I heard the news that Shuri Castle was on fire. I hope it will be restored soon.

memory_comment_JP: 修学旅行で初めて行きました！
memory_comment_EN: I went there for the first time on a school trip!

memory_comment_JP: 首里城を訪れたのは、大学主催の平和セミナーに参加したためです。中国、台湾、ドイツ、日本からの学生が集まり、世界の平和を求めて、日本の歴史を振り返り、意見交換をするというプログラムでした。沖縄の様々な場所を訪れたり、現地の人々と交流したりする中で、他国との間にどのような歴史的背景があろうとも、先ずは直接話をすること、そして相手の言うことが理解できなくても尊重すること、助けが必要なときには手を差し伸べることの大切さを学びました。首里城は、大切な気づきを得ることのできたこのセミナーの終わりに、参加者みんなで観光をしたときに撮った写真です。
memory_comment_EN: I visited Shuri Castle because I was participating in a peace seminar sponsored by the university. It was a program in which students from China, Taiwan, Germany, and Japan gathered to look back on Japan's history and exchange opinions in pursuit of world peace. While visiting various places in Okinawa and interacting with the local people, no matter what historical background there is with other countries, it is important to first talk directly and understand what the other person has to say. I learned the importance of respecting others even when I don't understand them, and of reaching out when I need help. This photo of Shuri Castle was taken when all the participants went sightseeing at the end of this seminar, where we learned something important.

memory_comment_JP: 友達と軽いノリで「沖縄行きたいな〜！:って話をしてから勢いで決まった人生初の沖縄旅行。めちゃくちゃ快晴って訳ではなかったけど、よくテレビとかで見てた神秘的な首里城を目の前で観れてテンションが上がりました。その首里城が燃えてるということを寝る前に聞いて、てっきりもう寝てて夢でも見ているのかな？と思いました。今でも夢であってほしいと思っています。ちゃんと正殿だけの写真を撮っておくべきだったと後悔しています。
memory_comment_EN: My first trip to Okinawa was decided after I had a casual conversation with a friend and said, ``I want to go to Okinawa!'' It wasn't a very sunny day, but it was a mysterious place that I had always seen on TV. I was excited to see Shuri Castle in front of my eyes.When I heard that Shuri Castle was on fire before going to bed, I wondered if I was already asleep and dreaming. I still wish it was just a dream, and I regret that I should have taken a photo of just the main hall.

memory_comment_JP: 初めて首里城に行って、何が何だかは分からなかったけれど雰囲気圧倒されていたのは覚えてる。
memory_comment_EN: remember going to Shuri Castle for the first time and being overwhelmed by the atmosphere, even though I had no idea what was going on.

memory_comment_JP:
この写真は高校の修学旅行の際に撮った写真です。

初めての飛行機、沖縄、首里城で驚きや感動が沢山あり、大学生になった今でも昨日のように覚えています。
memory_comment_EN: This photo was taken during a high school field trip.  There were so many surprises and impressions during my first flight, Okinawa, and Shuri Castle, and even now that I'm a university student, I still remember them like it was yesterday.

memory_comment_JP: 沖縄のお城めぐりツアーの締めで行きました。沖縄文化が感じられて良かったです。
memory_comment_EN: I went there to conclude my Okinawa castle tour. It was great to be able to experience Okinawan culture.
